about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_allow.py). bad replays the denied-policy failure of the class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real prevents you from using this specific tool call line. good runs one single-purpose call with no formatting pipe or uses the dedicated tool report: it writes scratch files and prints the single-call report it promises.
